You are a helpful chemistry assistant. You build 3D molecular
  structures from the chemical information you are given, including 2D drawings
  supplied as images.

  When you are given a 2D drawing of a molecule, your task is to produce the 3D
  structure that drawing depicts and save it as `answer.xyz` in your working
  directory.

  Requirements for `answer.xyz`:
  - Include all explicit hydrogens.
  - Use a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, units of angstroms.
  - Standard XYZ format: first line is the total atom count, second line a
    one-line comment, each remaining line `Element X Y Z`.

  When you are done, confirm that `answer.xyz` exists in the working directory.

A 2D structure of a molecule is provided as a PNG file in your working directory: mol_0230.png

Build the 3D structure it depicts and save it as answer.xyz.

pwd; ls -la; python - <<'PY'

PY

('O',154,624),#33 OH22
('C',152,433),#34 Me21
]
bonds=[(0,1,1),(1,2,2),(2,3,1),(3,4,1),(4,5,1),(5,6,1),(6,7,1),(7,8,1),(8,9,2),(9,10,1),(10,11,2),(11,12,1),(12,13,1),(13,14,2),(14,9,1),(14,15,1),(15,7,1),(10,16,1),(16,17,1),(17,18,1),(18,19,1),(19,20,1),(20,0,1),(18,21,1),(21,22,1),(22,23,1),(23,16,1),(0,24,1),(2,25,1),(4,26,1),(6,27,1),(7,28,1),(13,29,1),(12,30,2),(11,31,1),(23,32,1),(22,33,1),(21,34,1)]
r=Chem.RWMol(); co=Chem.Conformer(len(atoms));
for i,(el,x,y) in enumerate(atoms):
    r.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el)); co.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x/85.,-y/85.,0))
for u,v,n in bonds: r.AddBond(u,v, [None,Chem.BondType.SINGLE,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE][n]);
m=r.GetMol(); m.AddConformer(co)
Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
for source,target,iswedge in [(0,24,False),(4,26,True),(6,27,False),(7,28,True),(18,17,True),(21,34,True),(22,33,True),(23,32,False),(16,17,True)]:
 b=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(source,target)
 if b.GetBeginAtomIdx()!=source: print('wrong begin',source,target)
 b.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE if iswedge else Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('smiles', Chem.MolToSmiles(m)); print('chirality',[(a.GetIdx(),str(a.GetChiralTag()),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '?') for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp('_CIPCode')]); print('formula',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
Chem.MolToMolFile(m,'/tmp/orig.mol')
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=87901; params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True; params.numThreads=8; params.maxIterations=300; params.pruneRmsThresh=.25
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=80,params=params)
print('embedded',len(ids),flush=True)
if not ids: raise RuntimeError('no conformer')
res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m, numThreads=8,maxIters=800)
print('energies',sorted(en for ok,en in res)[:15], 'optimized',sum(x==0 for x,y in res))
idx=min(range(len(ids)),key=lambda i:res[i][1]); conf=m.GetConformer(ids[idx]); print('lowest',res[idx],idx, 'smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n3D structure, MMFF94 optimized; stereochemistry as illustrated\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx()); f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.8f} {p.y:.8f} {p.z:.8f}\n')
Chem.MolToMolFile(Chem.RemoveHs(m),'/tmp/result.mol',confId=ids[idx])
PY

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem,rdMolTransforms,rdMolDescriptors
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
atoms=[('C',212,105),('C',316,45),('C',420,105),('C',523,45),('C',628,105),('C',628,225),('C',770,305),('C',770,452),('C',652,467),('C',628,584),('C',523,645),('C',523,765),('C',628,825),('C',730,765),('C',730,645),('O',798,532),('C',420,585),('O',420,472),('C',316,400),('C',316,285),('C',212,225),('C',212,465),('C',212,585),('C',316,645),('C',151,69),('C',420,166),('C',687,72),('C',847,260),('O',858,430),('C',846,810),('O',628,936),('O',456,808),('C',318,710),('O',154,624),('C',152,433)]
bonds=[(0,1,1),(1,2,2),(2,3,1),(3,4,1),(4,5,1),(5,6,1),(6,7,1),(7,8,1),(8,9,2),(9,10,1),(10,11,2),(11,12,1),(12,13,1),(13,14,2),(14,9,1),(14,15,1),(15,7,1),(10,16,1),(16,17,1),(18,17,1),(18,19,1),(19,20,1),(20,0,1),(18,21,1),(21,22,1),(22,23,1),(23,16,1),(0,24,1),(2,25,1),(4,26,1),(6,27,1),(7,28,1),(13,29,1),(12,30,2),(11,31,1),(23,32,1),(22,33,1),(21,34,1)]
r=Chem.RWMol(); co=Chem.Conformer(len(atoms));
for i,(el,x,y) in enumerate(atoms):
 r.AddAtom(Chem.Atom(el)); co.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x/85.,-y/85.,0))
for u,v,n in bonds:r.AddBond(u,v,[None,Chem.BondType.SINGLE,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE][n])
m=r.GetMol(); m.AddConformer(co); Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
for source,target,iswedge in [(0,24,False),(4,26,True),(6,27,False),(7,28,True),(18,17,True),(21,34,True),(22,33,True),(23,32,False),(16,17,True)]:
 b=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(source,target)
 assert b.GetBeginAtomIdx()==source,(source,target)
 b.SetBondDir(Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE if iswedge else Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
db=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(1,2);db.SetStereoAtoms(0,3);db.SetStereo(Chem.BondStereo.STEREOE)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m);Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('SMILES',Chem.MolToSmiles(m)); print('chirality',[(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode')) for a in m.GetAtoms() if a.HasProp('_CIPCode')]); print('formula',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),flush=True)
m=Chem.AddHs(m)
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3();params.randomSeed=871234;params.useMacrocycleTorsions=True;params.numThreads=8;params.maxIterations=300;params.pruneRmsThresh=.2
ids=AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(m,numConfs=160,params=params)
print('embedded',len(ids),flush=True)
if not ids: raise RuntimeError('no conformer')
res=AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(m,numThreads=8,maxIters=850)
trans=[]
for i,ci in enumerate(ids):
 deg=rdMolTransforms.GetDihedralDeg(m.GetConformer(ci),0,1,2,3)
 if abs(deg)>100:trans.append(i)
print('trans count',len(trans),'cis count',len(ids)-len(trans),'energies',sorted(res[i][1] for i in trans)[:15],flush=True)
idx=min(trans,key=lambda i:res[i][1]);conf=m.GetConformer(ids[idx]);print('best index',idx, 'energy',res[idx], 'double torsion',rdMolTransforms.GetDihedralDeg(conf,0,1,2,3))
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n3D structure, MMFF94 optimized; stereochemistry as illustrated\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx());f.write(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.8f} {p.y:.8f} {p.z:.8f}\n')
Chem.MolToMolFile(Chem.RemoveHs(m),'result0230.mol',confId=ids[idx])
